schema.description: Frequently asked questions shown on the Portal's /faq page. Public: anyone can read the records; editing needs the entity's roles. Answers are Markdown. A visitor's 'Start a chat' creates a group chat for the question: the Portal links it with its consumer's Update scope.

answer.example: Rate limits control how many API requests you can make in a period. **Higher tiers** include more generous limits.

opey_prompt.example: Explain rate limits on this API and how I can see my consumer's current limits.
opey_prompt.description: Optional: what the 'Ask Opey' button sends to Opey for this question. Empty means Opey is asked the question itself.

category.description: Groups questions under a heading on the page. Empty means General.

chat_room_id.description: Optional: the chat_room_id of a Portal group chat about this question; shown as a 'Discuss in the group chat' link.

chat_joining_key.description: The joining key of that chat room, so a visitor can join it from the FAQ. Public by design: the room is meant for everyone.

sort_order.description: Position within its category, lowest first.
